04Governance

Four non-negotiables

  1. No guarantees. No agent states or implies that a veteran will receive a benefit, a rating percentage, a dollar amount, an approval, or a timeline. Every eligibility output is a status from the deterministic engine, never a promise.
  2. Everything is a recommendation. Resumes, plans, letters and checklists are drafts the veteran reviews, owns, and decides whether to use.
  3. The CFR is a reference, not a diagnosis. Agents may cite 38 CFR to explain how VA describes criteria; they never apply criteria to the veteran to produce a diagnosis, code or rating.
  4. Accredited representation is the path to a claim. Any conversation moving toward preparing, presenting or prosecuting a claim ends in a referral to a VA-accredited VSO representative, claims agent or attorney.

Claims legal lane (38 CFR 14.629, 14.636; 38 U.S.C. 5901). VetBuddy may inform, calculate, organize and refer. It may never prepare, sign, submit or argue a claim, ITF or review, and nothing claims-related may carry a fee. The GUARD VA Benefits Act (H.R. 1732) is pending; build as if it were enacted.

05Architecture

A modular monolith with four isolated services where credentials or untrusted files demand it. The CRM is a contained subsystem inside the Work OS, never the organizing model. Detail in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

1 Trust & IdentityAuth, tenancy, consent, privacy modes, audit. Built: tenancy, consent, audit; mock auth.
2 Work OSMaster Mission, Master Case, lanes, tasks, deadlines. Built: mission, cases, tasks.
3 Secure Context FabricGuardian, ContextPackets, policy decision and enforcement points. Not built.
4 Source IntelligenceJurisdictions, reference corpus, rule packs, determinations. Corpus loaded; 0 verified rules.
5 AI WorkforceOrchestrator and bounded specialists behind manifests. Manifests DRAFT; no runtime.
6 Integration GatewayVA connector (read-only, session-only), document intake (sandboxed), model gateway. Not built.
7 Operations CenterMonitoring, outbox worker, source polling, kill switch. Outbox table only.

Twelve non-interference invariants

#InvariantThis repo
I1Determinism: byte-identical output for fixed facts and epoch; clock injectedPartial router and ratings; no replay receipts
I2Fact isolation: broker projects each agent's allowlistNot present
I3No shared mutable state between agentsNo agents
I4Epoch pinning: a mid-flight pack publish can't change a running determinationPartial policy version and input hash per mission
I5Idempotency, at-most-once effectsPartial outbox keys; no dispatcher
I6Bounded authority: per-agent roles, FORCE RLS, no excess grantsPartial least-privilege app role; no per-agent roles
I7Untrusted-content quarantineNo uploads
I8Crisis preemption: the monitor can interrupt anythingNot present
I9Observability without identificationPartial logs carry ids only; audit stores no facts
I10Fail-closed: failures degrade toward uncertaintyTested
I11No agent-to-agent trustNo agents
I12Tenant and channel isolation; default denyTested tenants; channel split not built

Still to write first: the ADA metamorphic test. For any profile and any value of a health-derived fact, career output must not change. It gates the career module (CB-01, CB-02).

07Launch scope

Launch 0 · vetbuddy.com, static

A guest-only Alabama finder evaluated in the browser. It shows "verification required" until G1 closes, crisis help on every page, and real privacy, terms and accessibility pages. The standalone guest app already meets these privacy gates.

Launch 1 · app.vetbuddy.com

  • Authentication, profile and progressive intake
  • Master Case, tasks, deadlines, documents
  • Engine-backed Alabama discovery
  • ResourceHub (fed by the reference corpus)
  • Read-only claims organization
  • Constrained AI with a static router
  • Audit, account deletion, consent controls

Never, at any phase: storing an SSN; presenting AI output as an official determination; claiming a certification not held; presenting uncertain eligibility as guaranteed; presenting stale information as current.

11Next steps, in order

  1. Close G1. Name the verifier and verify the eight Alabama rules. Then the highest-risk reference rows: the 13 MST residential programs (2009 source), the G.I. Dependents' cap, 2026 VA and BAS rates, and the statutory timeline windows.
  2. Recover the v2.0 source, or re-transcribe the rating schedule from current eCFR.
  3. Decide G17 (identity provider and token model). It unblocks every remaining account release blocker in v6 §2–3: verification, recovery, MFA, step-up before deletion and the public deletion request, and the vault's account routes in production.
  4. Vault follow-through. Decide VD06 and VD21; then wire pull providers over the slice 03 stores, move vault store calls off the event loop (VD22), and start G1 review with the Alabama records and the 47 SOURCE_CHECKED rows.
  5. Slice 05. Outbox dispatcher with idempotent consumers (deletion already purges queued events), an axe and assistive-technology accessibility pass, and the v6 legal applicability register seeded with UNKNOWN rows for all 56 jurisdictions.
  6. Before any career module: the ADA metamorphic test and the fact-level allowlist (CB-01/02). The work-style assessment needs an instrument or licence decision first.
  7. Later, education-only content: insurance (VGLI/SGLI, no product rankings) and a regulatory change feed for VA law history, never a static page.
